# Time-Series-Library source

- Upstream: https://github.com/thuml/Time-Series-Library
- Pinned comparison commit: `4e938a1767106324dd753b2a44832bf870a0252e` (2026-04-18).
- License: MIT; complete original copyright and permission text in `LICENSE`.
- Delivered snapshot: `sotaband-hypoxemia-tslib-1`; file inventory and SHA-256 in `SOURCE.json`.

This is a dependency subset selected from the model catalogue's recursive Python imports,
not a copy of upstream experiments or datasets. The 45 upstream Python files and LICENSE
match the pinned commit after newline normalization. No upstream Python file was modified.

`layers/ClassificationHeads.py` and `models/_classification_hybrid_utils.py` are additions
from the supplied hypoxemia research source. Custom five-channel model compositions live
outside this vendor tree in `../../scripts/tslib_local_models.py`; unused waveform and
auxiliary-input model classes were removed during migration. These local additions are
maintained as SOTABand code under the project's MIT license.

The research backup did not contain Git metadata and recorded null library revisions in
its training metadata. Its original checkout commit cannot be recovered from that evidence.
The commit above identifies the verified content of the delivered upstream subset; it is
not a claim about the missing historical checkout. Source hashes pin the local additions.

Training weights such as best_model.pt are outputs, not part of this model implementation
dependency. They are excluded from source delivery and can be generated by training.
